skill.name: moai-baas-convex-ext
skill.description: Enterprise Convex Real-Time Backend with AI-powered reactive database

generated_query: I'm building a collaborative document editor where multiple users should see real-time updates to content and cursor positions. I need to design the backend architecture using Convex to handle the reactive data sync, conflict resolution, and authentication. Could you help me plan the schema, define the serverless functions for documents and cursors, set up real-time subscriptions so changes propagate instantly, and configure TypeScript types for end-to-end safety? Also, I'd like guidance on optimizing performance for low-latency updates when dozens of users edit the same document simultaneously. The app will eventually need to scale to thousands of concurrent editors.
